systems.name: Public Employee Retirement System of Idaho

statute.quote: A retirement and disability benefit system is created and placed under the management of a retirement board for the purpose of providing a retirement system and other benefits for public employees in the state of Idaho under this chapter.

body.name: Retirement Board of the Public Employee Retirement System of Idaho

source.quote: There is hereby created in the office of the governor a governing authority of the system to consist of a board of five (5) persons known as the retirement board.

website_source.quote: PERSI is directed by a five-member Retirement Board. Individuals on the Board are appointed by the Governor of the State of Idaho for terms lasting five years.

covers_local_source.quote: "Employer" means the state of Idaho or any political subdivision or governmental entity, provided such subdivision or entity has elected to come into the system.

systems.notes: The closed Firefighters' Retirement Fund (Idaho Code title 72, chapter 14) was transferred to and integrated with PERSI on October 1, 1980 (59-1392); its Census unit is grouped here.

systems.name: Judges' Retirement Fund

statute.quote: For the purpose of paying such retirement compensation, there is hereby created in the office of the treasurer of the state of Idaho a fund to be known as the "Judges' Retirement Fund,"

body.name: Retirement Board of the Public Employee Retirement System of Idaho

source.quote: The term "retirement board" as used in this chapter shall mean the retirement board created by section 59-1304, Idaho Code.

systems.notes: Covers supreme court justices, court of appeals judges and district judges; administered by the PERSI retirement board. No official HTML page naming the fund was found.
